name: Iru
title: Son of Caleb
summary: Iru was the eldest son of Caleb, son of Jephunneh, and is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles. He is part of the significant Calebite clan that played an important role during the conquest of Canaan. Although little is known about his personal life, his place in the genealogical record is important for understanding the history of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Iru is mentioned as the firstborn son of Caleb in the genealogical record of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's Inheritance in Canaan
keyEvents.description: As a son of Caleb, Iru was part of a family that received an important inheritance in the Promised Land after his father faithfully followed the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's Faithfulness and Promise
keyEvents.description: Caleb's faithfulness to the Lord secured an inheritance for his descendants, including Iru, as he was one of the two spies who trusted in God's promise.

keyEvents.title: Caleb Takes Hebron
keyEvents.description: Caleb's conquest of the Hebron area laid the foundation for his family's settlement, which also included Iru and his brothers.
